description: Phase 13 evaluation application: what the source cannot say. Checkout clients resubmit when they get no response; the welcome queue delivers at least once; four business rules. Only the Phase 11/12 contract vocabulary is used.

src/services/orders.ts#placeOrder.description: POST /checkout; the client resubmits the same request when it gets no response.

src/services/orders.ts#placeOrderIdempot.description: As placeOrder, with the client's checkout id.

src/workers/welcome.ts#handleWelcomeJob.description: The queue redelivers a job whose acknowledgment it did not receive.

invariants.name: one-order-per-cart
invariants.description: A cart is checked out into at most one order.

invariants.name: one-payment-per-order
invariants.description: An order is paid at most once.

invariants.name: one-welcome-per-user
invariants.description: A user receives at most one welcome notification.

invariants.name: one-team-per-owner
invariants.description: A user owns at most one team (product rule).
